newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fukuda Denshi restates profit due to embezzlement.
newsitem.headline: Fukuda Denshi restates profit due to embezzlement.

text.p: Japan's Fukuda Denshi Co Ltd said on Wednesday it had revised downward its group net profit for the last business year, stating that it recently found that an employee of a subsidiary embezzled cash, resulting in a special loss of 965 million yen for the year.
As a result of the loss, the company restated its group net profit for 1996/97 at 2.65 billion yen, up 7.0 percent from the year before, and its earnings per share at 136.67 yen.
On June 5, the company announced a group net profit of 3.62 billion yen for 1996/97 and earnings per share of 186.45.
The medical electronics equipment manufacturer said in a statement that it would take necessary legal action in response to the embezzlement.
